Implement enhanced nearest-neighbor construction: begin with the city having the smallest x-coordinate, then iteratively select the nearest unvisited city that minimizes total tour length. Prioritize moves that avoid edge crossings by checking if new connections intersect existing edges. After constructing your tour, rigorously verify all 20 cities appear exactly once. Calculate total length and ensure improvement over examples. Focus on maintaining tour coherence while minimizing distance. Output only the optimal tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format. Double-check your solution for correctness before output.
